result:
The audit warning on `PostController.store` is gone, and `bun run typecheck` still passes. `bunx guren audit` still reports one failure and one warning. Both are dependency advisories (`source-map-js` and `katex`) that this change didn't touch. I didn't run the test suite or boot the app.

`store` now creates the post with `Post.create(data, { set: { authorId: author.id } })` instead of `forceCreate`. To make `set` work I removed `authorId` from `fillable` in `app/Models/Post.ts`, because `set` rejects any key that is also fillable.

`store` and `update` now both discard an `authorId` sent in the request body. Before, `update` would have let a client change a post's author.
